DIAGNOSIS READY: Drug-Induced Akathisia secondary to Risperidone.

The clinical picture of inner restlessness, inability to stay still, and repetitive movements like leg crossing and pacing appearing after starting risperidone is classic for this side effect. Given the clear cause and characteristic symptoms, no further testing is required.
